_note: Selector declared before any test figure is read. C(lambda) = C_miss + lambda * C_false_alarm, lambda >= 0, where lambda scales the alarm side relative to the missed-attack side; lambda = 1 reproduces the accepted per-class weights of configs/xiiotid_severity_cost.json. Those weights are relative hypotheses, not measured monetary damage. Attack-to-attack confusions stay counted and unweighted.

selector.rule: argmin of C(lambda) over the pool
selector.tie_break: lowest C_miss, then variant name ascending
